_meta.description: Current audit scope — what the next expert fleet sweep must check. Grows as findings reveal new check categories.
_meta.rule: APPEND ONLY. Each new scope item references the finding that triggered it.

scope_items.label: Authentication enforcement check
scope_items.check: Does every route have auth middleware before the handler?

scope_items.label: Injection scan completeness
scope_items.check: Is scanForInjection() called on every string input across all endpoints, including secondary rounds?

scope_items.label: Synchronous I/O on hot paths
scope_items.check: Are there any readFileSync/writeFileSync calls inside request handlers?

scope_items.label: Record immutability check
scope_items.check: Are classification fields on CR records immutable after creation? No overwrite permitted.

scope_items.label: Live source enforcement per rule
scope_items.check: Does every gate rule read from a live source, not a constant or stub value?

scope_items.label: User actionable next-step in results
scope_items.check: Does every result state in the gate UI provide a specific actionable next-step for the user?

scope_items.label: MOCK_MODE flag on stub rules
scope_items.check: Do all Phase 0.5 stub rules return a mock_mode: true field in their response? Silent stubs are prohibited.

scope_items.label: CR-ID overflow handling
scope_items.check: Does generateCrId() handle >999 records per day without silently breaking the format?

scope_items.label: Governor dashboard action verbs
scope_items.check: Does the Governor dashboard have Approve/Reject/Clear Quarantine/Annotate actions, not just read-only display?

scope_items.label: API versioning headers
scope_items.check: Do all /api/* responses include X-CDS-API-Version header?

next_audit_target: After P1-P6 prevention rules applied to codebase
